alternatives_rejected.why: Own span self-time is flat (p50 0.01->0.01ms, 0.91x) while inbound latency rose 95.89x (E2), and cpu is not among its significant metric deviations (E3).
Its latency-90 deviation (86498.2%) is smaller than productcatalogservice's (134699.0%) (E1), which fits recommendationservice inheriting delay from a dependency.
Frontend errors appear alongside large latency growth on calls into productcatalogservice, whose inbound errors also rose 0.0->0.0185 (E2), so they look like a downstream symptom.

proposed_fix.description: Find and remove the network delay affecting productcatalogservice pods, such as a tc/netem qdisc, a chaos experiment, or a sidecar/network policy change, then confirm inbound p50 returns to about 2ms. If the source can't be found quickly, restart the productcatalogservice pods.
